title: Microduck - intent level (mj_host --level2)
launch_hint: ./mj_host/run.sh launcher → a level-2 preset, or ogma_mjhost --level2 --graph <config>
description: The duck above Pollen's walking policy: the brain senses body velocity and publishes a twist intent (mj_host/src/IntentAdapter.cpp).

sources.name: intent
sources.description: the sensed body velocity in the walker's command units [vx vy vyaw], each unit-clamped

sources.name: imu
sources.description: projected gravity [g_x g_y g_z] + gyro [w_x w_y w_z]

sources.name: sense
sources.description: 12 load slots + 4 ToF: g_x, g_y, pitch rate ·0.3, roll rate ·0.3, yaw rate ·0.3, accel x/20, y/20, z/20, sensed vx, sensed vy, heading deviation from its 60 s average /π, map TLE, tof[0..3]

sources.name: place_in
sources.description: the map EPM's input: the place signature the adapter composes

sinks.name: vx
sinks.description: forward velocity command, unit-scaled to the walker's range

reads.name: place
reads.description: the host reads the map EPM's token: winner = place id, TLE = map surprise (slot 11 of sense)

events.name: reset
events.description: fired when the recovery harness stands the body back up
